description:
The Government is issuing this DRAFT Request for Proposal (RFP), Solicitation Number HT001526RE001, for Clinical Reference Laboratory Testing Services.

Please note the following key information regarding this draft release:

  • Anticipated Changes: The Government does not anticipate any major modifications to this Draft RFP or its associated attachments prior to final release.

  • Questions: Questions will not be accepted in response to this Draft Solicitation. Instructions for submitting questions will be provided upon the release of the final solicitation.

  • Final Solicitation: The Final Solicitation is scheduled to be issued within the next seven (7) days.

Please review the attached documents for full details:

  1. RFP HT001526RE001
  2. Attachment 1 PWS
  3. Attachment 2 Addendum to FAR 52.212-1
  4. Attachment 3 Addendum to FAR 52.212-2
  5. Exhibit A – Price List
  6. Exhibit C – Past Performance Summary Sheet

  8. Exhibit E – Subcontractor Teaming Partner Letter and Table
  9. PWS Attachment 1 -Summary of DoD sites
  10. PWS Attachment 2 – DD Form1423-1
  11. PWS Attachment 3 – B2B Gateway Implementation
  12. PWS Attachment 4 – DHA CAC Request Process
